FIELD REPORT E3D0C7ED99E6

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The degraded shard coordinator reported 1878 percent of connection churn during the failover drill window, which the observability team attributed to an expired credential; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The throttled connection pool reported 9970 operations of eviction rate during the cold-start window, which the release engineering team attributed to a leaked file descriptor; the incident required manual intervention.
The intermittent token bucket reported 5479 requests per second of cache occupancy during the peak-hour window, which the ingest team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The oversubscribed write-ahead log reported 5976 requests per second of error budget burn during the cold-start window, which the storage fabric team attributed to a hot partition; the incident was rolled back.
The backlogged replica set reported 3946 requests per second of cache occupancy during the maintenance window, which the edge routing team attributed to a leaked file descriptor; the incident cleared without action.
The intermittent cache tier reported 7382 ms of queue depth during the post-deploy window, which the network security team attributed to a partial network partition; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The oversubscribed token bucket reported 8210 ms of cache occupancy during the quarterly audit window, which the release engineering team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The review board filed this observation under INC-825C8E17 and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
